subject: Accelerator pathway: MAP staging, pilot credit cadence, and conversion economics
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.example>
To: Maria Gutierrez <maria@finalyze.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.example, jordan_blake@redwood.example
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft + pilot credit cadence (initial)

Hi Maria —

Thanks again for a great conversation this morning. Attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) that stages acceptance criteria over a 12-week evaluation. Key items I highlighted:

- Week 1–2: sandbox onboarding + performance baseline (no credit consumption cap)
- Week 3–6: integration POC (10k tokens/day pilot allocation)
- Week 7–12: production-facing load test & acceptance gates (ramp to 50k tokens/day)

We propose an initial pilot credit allocation of $25k to cover the integration POC and the early ramp, with the ability to tranche a second credit disbursement ($15k) if Week 6 acceptance is met. If you approve, I’ll formalize the MAP and surface the staged credit schedule in the SOW.

Two questions for you before I update the doc:
1) Do you want the second tranche to be automatic upon acceptance or require signoff from your procurement team?
2) Any constraints on billing cadence if we move to a conversion contract after Week 12?

I attached the MAP and a lightweight SOW draft for context.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.example
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: 2026-07-28_Finalyze_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP spreadsheet), SOW_draft_v3.pdf (SOW stub)
From: Maria Gutierrez <maria@finalyze.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.example>
Cc: Rajiv Shah <rajiv@finalyze.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.example
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft + pilot credit cadence (initial)

Naomi —

Thanks for the clear layout. A couple quick items from our side:

- We prefer the second tranche to require a short procurement signoff (Rajiv will own).
- On billing cadence: we generally do annual billing for platform spend but can consider quarterly during the first year while usage stabilizes.
- One ask: can we have the Week 3–6 tranche tied to specific latency and throughput targets (95th percentile latency < 250ms at 10k TPS)?

I'll review the MAP spreadsheet with Rajiv and get back with redlines by Friday.

—Maria
VP, Engineering | Finalyze
maria@finalyze.com

Maria / Naomi —

Thanks for looping me in. A couple of technical clarifications on the acceptance gates:

- The 95th percentile latency target is reasonable but we should define the test harness (payload mix + token lengths). I'll drop a proposed test plan into the MAP tab.
- For the tranche release, we can automate a credit unlock when the test harness posts a passed result to our API endpoint, and we can include a manual approval step for Finalyze if you prefer.

Naomi — once Maria confirms the test payload, I’ll add the technical acceptance criteria and the automated unlock flow to the MAP spreadsheet.

-Karthik
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.example

From: Rajiv Shah <rajiv@finalyze.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.example>, Maria Gutierrez <maria@finalyze.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + pilot credit cadence (initial)

Naomi —

Quick procurement note: we will require an internal PO if total committed credits exceed $30k. If you can keep the initial tranche at $25k and make the second tranche contingent on explicit signoff (not automatic), that keeps us under the PO threshold and speeds approvals.

Also, please include an option in the SOW to convert credits to a pre-paid commitment at a defined discount (we typically look for a 15–20% discount on committed annual spend).

-Rajiv
VP, Procurement | Finalyze
rajiv@finalyze.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.example>
To: Maria Gutierrez <maria@finalyze.com>, Rajiv Shah <rajiv@finalyze.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.example, jordan_blake@redwood.example
Date: Wed, 04 Aug 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: MAP v1.1 + updated credit cadence (attached)

Team —

I’ve incorporated the procurement constraint and the acceptance gating language. Changes in the attached MAP_v1.1: 

- Tranche 1: $25k pilot credit, disbursed on kickoff (Week 0)
- Tranche 2: $15k pilot credit, disbursed on signed acceptance by Finalyze (Week 6)
- Added explicit test harness details and payload mix for the 95th percentile latency target
- SOW now includes a conversion clause: convert unused pilot credits to first-year committed spend at a 18% discount if Finalyze signs within 30 days of acceptance

Next steps: Maria / Rajiv — confirm the manual signoff flow and we’ll ship the SOW for legal review. Jordan — can you prepare an anchor price for a 12-month commit (three tiers: 250k, 500k, 1M tokens/month) and slot the 18% conversion discount into the model?

Thanks,
Naomi
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2026-07-28_Finalyze_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated to v1.1), SOW_draft_v3.pdf, pilot_usage_report.csv
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.example>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.example>, Maria Gutierrez <maria@finalyze.com>, Rajiv Shah <rajiv@finalyze.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.example
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP v1.1 + updated credit cadence (attached)

Folks —

Attaching the anchor pricing matrix and an example conversion schedule. High-level summary:

- Tier A (250k tokens/mo): $120k/year prepaid; effective per-token ~$0.00048
- Tier B (500k tokens/mo): $210k/year prepaid; effective per-token ~$0.00035
- Tier C (1M tokens/mo): $380k/year prepaid; effective per-token ~$0.00032

Applying the 18% conversion discount to unused pilot credits gives Finalyze a clear path to convert pilot value into committed dollars while preserving predictable unit economics. If you want, we can model a quarterly billing cadence for Year 1 that smooths cash flow and keeps procurement comfortable.

Can we lock the MAP this week so legal has time to loop for a quick SOW review?

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Commercial Lead | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Finalyze_anchor_pricing.xlsx (pricing matrix)
